name: Media Player
long_description: One player for the badge's media. Video opens .avi with the sound inside (MJPEG plus 8/16-bit PCM or IMA ADPCM audio) or raw .mjpeg/.mjpg streams with an optional WAV sidecar, shown 1:1 at the clip's recorded frame rate, dropping frames to keep real time. Audio plays .wav and .mp3 through AudioManager, with volume from the audio settings, and .rtttl ringtones through the buzzer. Tap the picture or the music note to pause and play; a control bar appears with a scrub bar for jumping anywhere, with <<, >> (fifteen seconds), restart, play/pause and close. For audio the bar stays on screen and seeking is sample-accurate on WAV and frame-accurate on MP3; RTTTL has no sample position, so it shows restart and close only. The A button pauses, B/Y seek and X leaves. Pick one file, several, or a whole folder: a folder plays everything in it in name order, so the picker doubles as a playlist, and video, audio and ringtones can be mixed. An unsupported container or codec says which one it is instead of failing silently. Launching without a file opens the picker; the benchmark buttons measure the panel's frame rate.
